content.text: Abstract written to `docs/paper/sections/abstract.tex`. ~210 words, covering problem (representation directions detect sycophancy), method (three GRPO reward formulations tested), negative result (all fail, including behavioral-only), mechanism (discriminability does not equal reward utility), and implication (detection geometry is not optimization geometry).
